title: Rules-Lookup Hotspot Finder
dataSources: Campaign sessions (`campaign:session`), NPC ledger (`npc:ledger`), loot drops (`loot:drop`), XP awards (`xp:award`).
app: Tabletop RPG telemetry — virtual-tabletop session logs (Roll20, Foundry VTT), campaign trackers (World Anvil), and XP / loot / NPC ledgers — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=campaign:session rule_lookup=*
| stats count as lookups, dc(session_id) as sessions by rule_lookup
| sort - lookups
description: Ranks the rules questions or mechanics that cause the most table slowdowns and lookups.
value: If the same rules create friction every week, that is the best place to add a cheat sheet or simplification.
implementation: Tag rules lookups in session logs and count them by rule name and distinct sessions.
visualization: Bar chart of most common rules lookups.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks which rules you keep stopping to check so you can make the table run more smoothly.
